entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A soratami planeswalker from Kamigawa who chronicles truths, wields story scrolls as magic, and refuses to use the iron-bound scroll to save Jace.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker, calmed by Tamiyo after his madness, who links minds with her and tries to subdue Avacyn.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel of Innistrad, now mad and bloody-winged, who attacks Tamiyo and Jace and is the source of the angels' madness though not its origin.

entities.name: Jenrik
entities.description: A trustworthy human to whom Tamiyo gave her field notes, who died at Markov Manor.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer whom Jace murmurs about when he recovers.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The creator of the myr, whose loss left them without purpose in Tamiyo's story.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane that Tamiyo says is off its axis, with Avacyn as its core.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Tamiyo's home plane, with an endless library in the clouds.

entities.name: Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: The cathedral where Tamiyo seeks the oldest histories of Avacyn and where Jace and Avacyn clash.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: The ruined manor where Jenrik died.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: A lost place whose cataclysm and survivors are told in one of Tamiyo's iron-bound scrolls.

entities.name: Iron-Bound Scrolls
entities.description: Three powerful story scrolls bound in iron bands that Tamiyo believes must never be used.

entities.name: Story Scrolls
entities.description: Scrolls of stories that Tamiyo invokes to cast magic, such as He Who Frightens the Sun, Original and Winter's Howl.

entities.name: Myr
entities.description: Artificial creatures in Tamiyo's story Original, who multiplied after one copied its mind incompletely.

entities.name: Soratami
entities.description: The moonfolk of Kamigawa, disciplined and powerful of mind.

events.summary: Tamiyo drifts through Thraben Cathedral's chantry, investigating why Innistrad is off its axis.
events.quote: Despite the fact that her feet never touched the stone floor, Tamiyo thought about tiptoeing as she slowly drifted through the chantry of Thraben Cathedral.

events.summary: Tamiyo has come to the cathedral to study the oldest histories of Avacyn.
events.quote: Her latest line of research had brought her to the cathedral, where the humans of Innistrad housed their oldest histories of Avacyn.

events.summary: Tamiyo invokes the story He Who Frightens the Sun to blend in unseen among the cathars.
events.quote: The story invoked, its magic became real, and Tamiyo faded from view.

events.summary: Tamiyo finds a young planeswalker holding her field notes standing over a collapsed librarian.
events.quote: And standing over him...a Planeswalker.

events.summary: Jace, mad, commands her to help him; Tamiyo shields her mind and uses the story Original to calm his thoughts.
events.quote: But her mind withdrew to a far-off castle, and the winds could not reach her.

events.summary: Jace's eyes grow calm and he recovers his senses.
events.quote: The young human's eyes closed, and he took several deep, slow breaths.

events.summary: Jace introduces himself and Tamiyo asks about Jenrik, learning he did not survive Markov Manor.
events.quote: he didn't survive it.

events.summary: Tamiyo tells Jace to leave, warning that a mad telepath is a danger across planes.
events.quote: You need to leave, Jace.

events.summary: Jace offers to find out what afflicts Avacyn and stop her if necessary.
events.quote: I can find out what's afflicting her.

events.summary: Tamiyo says she is here only to understand and chronicle, and expects the plane to be doomed.
events.quote: I am not here to fix this world's problem. I am here to understand it.

events.summary: Tamiyo agrees to anchor Jace's mind if they link minds, and Jace accepts.
events.quote: But...in theory, I could anchor you.

events.summary: Tamiyo and Jace link minds, each learning the other's past and burdens.
events.quote: In an instant, he knew her.

events.summary: Tamiyo senses her veiling spell pierced as a powerful presence approaches.
events.quote: Jace, my veiling spell has been pierced.

events.summary: Avacyn arrives in the central chapel, wings bloodied and spear aflame.
events.quote: The angel hovered, her massive wings stained with fresh blood, her spear molten and ablaze.

events.summary: Avacyn brands Tamiyo an intruder and impure and attacks.
events.quote: Intruder. Invader. Rotmonger. Impure! IMPURE!

events.summary: Tamiyo fights Avacyn with the story Winter's Howl, freezing parts of her wings.
events.quote: Tamiyo let loose precisely targeted blasts of icy gale

events.summary: Avacyn freezes in place under Jace's mental assault while her light presses down on them.
events.quote: And then she froze.

events.summary: Jace learns that Avacyn is the source of the angels' madness but not its origin, and that she holds something else at bay.
events.quote: She's the source of the madness among the angels.

events.summary: Avacyn's light turns foul; she breaks free and tortures Jace.
events.quote: She reached down and placed her hand on his chest.

events.summary: Jace begs Tamiyo to read the iron scroll about Serra's realm; she refuses to open it.
events.quote: No, Jace. The scroll stays closed.

events.summary: Tamiyo tells the dying Jace that sometimes stories have to end.
events.quote: Sometimes, our stories have to end.

relations.quote: the journal's author, the moonfolk Planeswalker called Tamiyo

relations.note: She entrusted her field notes to him.
relations.quote: I gave them to someone trustworthy

relations.note: Uneasy temporary partners after linking minds.
relations.quote: Tamiyo, I just want to help.

relations.note: Avacyn sees her as an intruder to protect against.
She calls him defiler and attacks him.
In Tamiyo's story, the myr were lost when their creator Memnarch was gone.
relations.quote: With their creator gone, the creatures known as the myr were lost.
